admin.title: Settings
admin.noDelete: Nothing is ever deleted, so history stays complete. To stop using something, switch off “Active”.
admin.modelsHelp: Add each model by hand. “Code in the serial” is the part of the serial number that identifies the model.
admin.colorsHelp: “Code in the serial” is the part of the serial number that identifies the color.
admin.serialRulesHelp: How to read the model, color and date from a serial number. Until a rule matches, the tester picks the model and color by hand.
admin.categoriesHelp: Washing machine, dryer, fridge… Each product type has its own models, defects, parts and checklist.
admin.maxRetestFails: Alert the supervisor after this many failed retests
admin.idleLock: Sign out automatically after (minutes without activity)
admin.pinKeep: Leave empty to keep the current PIN
admin.noMatch: This serial does not match the pattern.
admin.patternHelp: Regular expression with named parts: (?<model>…) required, (?<color>…), (?<year>..), (?<month>..) optional. Example: ^(?<model>[A-Z0-9]{4})(?<color>[A-Z])(?<year>\d{2})(?<month>\d{2})\d{6}$
admin.modelTarget: First-pass yield target for this model (%) — empty = general target
admin.partsHelp: The spare parts catalog. Repairmen pick parts from it and the stock goes down automatically. Set a minimum to get a low-stock alert.
admin.stockFromPartsPage: Change stock from the Spare parts page (received / inventory count).
admin.textsHelp: Change any wording on the screens. Changed texts are highlighted. Clear a box to go back to the original text. Changes reach every PC immediately.

help.title: Help
help.intro: Quick steps for your work. Ask your supervisor if something is not clear.

rules.r1: Only the test room can pass or fail a unit.
rules.r2: Nobody can pass a unit they repaired themselves.
rules.r3: A repair goes back to the test room only after at least one repair is logged.
rules.r4: Nothing is ever deleted: every test and repair stays in the history.
rules.r5: The PC signs you out after a few minutes without activity. Always sign out when you leave.

tester.title: Test room
tester.s1: Sign in with your employee ID and PIN.
tester.s2: Scan the serial number of the unit. Model and color appear by themselves (or choose them).
tester.s3: Test the unit. Mark with ✗ every check that fails. Type the measured values.
tester.s5: Problem: press FAIL, choose the defect, add a note and photos.
tester.s6: Print the repair tag and stick it on the unit, then send it to the repair area.
tester.s7: Units back from repair appear in “Coming back from repair”. Scan and test them again.

repairman.title: Repair
repairman.s1: Sign in. Units that failed again are at the top, in red: do them first.
repairman.s2: Take a new unit with “Take it”, or scan its serial number / repair tag.
repairman.s3: Read what the test room found (defect, failed checks, photos).
repairman.s4: Log the fault you actually found.
repairman.s5: Log each repair: part of the machine, what you did, spare parts from stock, time.
repairman.s6: No spare part? Press “Waiting for parts”, then “Resume” when it arrives.
repairman.s7: Finished: press “Send back to test room”. Only the test room can pass the unit.

supervisor.title: Supervisor
supervisor.s1: Repair screen: see all open repairs, give a repair to another repairman.
supervisor.s2: Red alert = a unit failed the retest too many times: check it and decide (repair or scrap).
supervisor.s3: Reports: first-pass yield, defects, repair times, people. Export to Excel or print.
supervisor.s4: Spare parts: record deliveries and inventory counts; watch low-stock alerts.
supervisor.s5: Units: search any serial number to see its full history, print it or scrap the unit.
supervisor.s6: Change log (user menu): who did what and when.

admin.title: Admin
admin.s1: First: change the admin PIN (user menu → Change my PIN).
admin.s2: Settings → People: add testers, repairmen and supervisors.
admin.s3: Settings → Models and Colors: add your products and their codes in the serial number.
admin.s4: Settings → Serial number: set the rule, test it with a real serial.
admin.s5: Check defect codes, checklist, machine parts, spare parts and their translations.
admin.s6: Screen texts: change any wording in French, Arabic or English.

line.title: Production line screen
line.s1: The big screen shows today's results live: no need to sign in.
line.s2: Green = on target, orange = slightly below, red = below target.
line.s3: Top defects tell the line what to fix first.
